newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil net dollar inflows at $1.162 bln Aug 4.
newsitem.headline: Brazil net dollar inflows at $1.162 bln Aug 4.

text.p: Preliminary figures for Brazil's commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a whopping $1.162 billion surplus on August 4 in the commercial forex market, according to Central Bank data suplied to banks.

Dealers estimated at least $500 million from financial buy was due to the payment for part of a controlling stake in Bahia state electrical company Coelba, which was sold at auction last week by the Brazilian government. The winning consortium paid a total of $1.6 billion for the stake in Coelba.
